definitions: Experiencing the same unpleasant treatment that one has given to others.
Receiving the same negative treatment or consequences that one has inflicted on others.
examples: After years of pranking his friends, he finally got a taste of his own medicine when they all ganged up on him.
She was always critical of others' work, and now that her own project is under scrutiny, she's getting a taste of her own medicine.
The bully got a taste of his own medicine when a new student stood up to him.
lemma: a taste of one's own medicine
source: a taste of your own medicine
